notes.title: Play The Brand New Demo Now!
notes.content:
Hey everyone!

[h1]A brand-new demo![/h1]

The studio has been reset, the audience is waiting, all that is left is you, the contestant! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40723425/f216a2e436d43a75035c663f17ed87aa9a05be00.png[/img]

Dive into the new demo for DEATHRUN TV and unleash mayhem on the greatest TV show in the world. 

With every run, you edge towards exciting [b]new skills and weapon unlocks[/b] to wreak havoc on the many, many obstacles out to get you.

[h1]Twitch Integration - Take your seat in the studio audience![/h1]

Not only can you be the player, but you now you can also take part in the DEATHRUN TV audience experience! Watch your favourite streamers playing the game and [b]impact what is happening right from the Twitch chat![/b]

Will you [b]spawn a monstrous avatar of yourself[/b], complete with your Twitch username, right into the streamer's game and watch them do battle?

Will you perhaps grant the streamer a boon in the form of [b]invincibility or hyperspeed[/b]?

Maybe you just want to watch the world burn and [b]unleash a never-ending horde of enemies[/b] on the unsuspecting streamer. 

[b]Next time you hop into a Twitch stream, type the following into chat at the beginning of a round to get involved![/b]

[b]#saveme[/b]
You spawn into the game as a prisoner that the contestant can choose to save, or leave to die.

[b]#spawn[/b]
You spawn into the game as a monster. Will you kill the contestant, or will they kill you?

[b]#like[/b]
You love the contestant. Give them loads of likes to increase their score

At the start of each round, views can vote on a “powerup” that changes how the round plays by typing [b]#A, #B, #C[/b], or [b]#D[/b]. Sometimes these powerups are positives, some negative.
[list]
[list]
[*] Invincibility – the player cant be killed.
[*] Bullet time – Become 'the one' as the world slows down around you.
[*] Massive- the player gets huge, a bigger target but you can crush enemies beneath your feet!
[*] Tiny – the player becomes teeny tiny, a smaller target!
[*] Mega-Damage – player does mega damage.
[*] Horde – Hundreds of weak enemies spawn constantly.
[/list]
[/list]
[b]The world is your oyster, go and cause some trouble![/b]

[b]Are you a streamer brave enough to put your fate in the hands of the audience?[/b]
Connecting DEATHRUN TV to your Twitch account is as simple as [url=https://twitchapps.com/tmi/]generating an OAUTH token from here[/url] and connecting with your Twitch account name. There are a few options to allow you to customise how often the players can interact with you, we would love to hear your feedback on this as a Streamer!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40723425/70960e4f6f95b47836b8f084939ae41b473f740c.png[/img]

Player feedback is always incredibly valuable to us so be sure to let us know what you think! if you come across any bugs we would welcome your bug reports [url=https://airtable.com/shrPtU41WmLt0BCBR]right here[/url]. 

Join the DEATHRUN TV Community in the [url=https://discord.gg/deathruntv]official Discord Server[/url].

notes.title: Hotfix #3
notes.content:
Hey everyone!

Fancy a bit of DEATHRUN TV this weekend?

Well lucky you, the devs at Laser Dog have been hard at work actioning feedback, adjusting the studio lights and come up with another update to the pilot episode!

[u][b]Here's a lit of all the changes[/b][/u]
[list]
[*] Tap roll to cancel slow-mo in roll.
[*] Enemies receive 3x the damage from explosions that players do.
[*] Added interactable UI prompts.
[*] Increase the size of the weapon UI and made the bars scale from the middle.
[*] Fixed duplicate mutations appearing in the mutation selection screen (Allowing all mutations on this screen).
[*] Tweaked weapon 'charge' UI to show when you're almost out of charge.
[*] Managed the replicate the issue where a buzzer doesn't enable when you kill all enemies and fixed. Hoping that was the only case but keeping our eye on it!
[*] Prevent pausing on death screen.
[*] Added invulnerable time when hitting certain things such as slime trails.
[*] Made bloom work again - for targetting enemies.
[*] Fixed gameplay controller screen being active during pause/mutation screen.
[*] Prevent rockets exploding in walls when shooting next to a top wall
[*] Greater 'safe spawn area' in arenas.
[*] 2.6D?
[*] Bigger - closer weapon UI.
[*] In game UI on pickups.
[*] Fix grenade pickup and better grenades.
[*] Balance and difficulty tweaks.
[*] Slight buff on gold weapons.
[*] Weapon tweaks.
[/list]
As always we are so grateful for the amazing feedback and love hearing how much fun you're having with the demo.

If you haven't already, head over to the Discord and join the growing community of Deathrunners!

notes.title: Hotfix #2
notes.content:
Hey deathrunners!

What a few days it's been! We're blown away by the love for the pilot episode and the creative ways you have been challenging yourselves to complete the demo.

There's no secret ending, honest. We wouldn't lie about this. Don't worry about anything you hear about golden keys and secret doors...

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40723425/37d027b1f7beb035fea45ebd098e69849d5f50b9.jpg[/img]

Anyway... We've been hard at work going through the [b]incredible[/b] feedback you have all been sharing, so here is the list of updates in Hotfix #2

[u][b]Changes[/b][/u]

[list]
[*] Rebalanced health, armour and damage systems. Enemies can do more than 1/2 heart damage.
[*] Fixed typo in death screen.
[*] Tightened up the roll mechanic.
[*] Fixed issue with sprite atlases showing overlapping sprites in UI.
[*] Prevent level gen placing objects inside boss lift.
[*] Prevent razers from moving when player is in spawn state.
[*] Shoot razers to change their direction.
[*] Made the out wall of level indestructible (5 cells from edge).
[*] No grenades on start, because who doesn't like a challenge?
[*] Grenades now explode when they hit an enemy.
[*] Various big fixes.
[*] Added lite shotgun.
[*] Laser pointer on Hitscan enemies.
[*] Added all mutations into "mutation UI".
[*] Tutorial - added pickupequip item.
[*] Tutorial - added swap equip item moment.
[*] Tutorial - added proximity mine moment.
[*] Spawner zombies no longer spawn directly on player.
[*] Difficulty / Balance tweaks - Champion bosses.
[*] Difficulty / Balance tweaks - Monsters
[*] Difficulty / Balance tweaks - Weapons
[/list]

If you haven't already please come and join the [url=https://discord.gg/deathruntv]Discord server[/url] and the growing community of deathrunners!

We [b]LOVE[/b] your feedback, so please, please keep it coming.

Thanks and have fun!

notes.title: Welcome to DEATHRUN TV
notes.content:
We are incredibly excited to reveal [b]DEATHRUN TV[/b], from indie developer Laser Dog!

DEATHRUN TV is the greatest game show on earth, a breakneck speed, bullet dodging action rogue-like.

Broadcast live from the largest TV studio ever created contestants risk it all to gather likes from the audience!

[u][b]Game Features[/b][/u]

[list]
[*] Contestants who rack up those likes and level up their likeability can choose from a range of mutations to take with them on their run and change up the gameplay.
[*] 
[*] Met a grisly end on your run? Not to worry! State of the art proprietary technology means death is merely a brief inconvenience before you come back to try again, again and again!
[*] 
[*] Contestants can take on a run solo, but mayhem is more fun with friends, right? Get up to three friends together and wreak havoc in 1-4 player local multiplayer.
[*] 
[*] Like any good gameshow, DeathRun TV engages the audience. Viewers around the globe on Twitch can vote on the challenges you face and affect your run in a variety of ways.
[/list]
